parsed.name: 串口流接口组件
parsed.description: 用于实验系统中的非物理串口通信组件，提供对串行端口的数据写入、读取和连接关闭功能，作为上层程序与各类串口设备交换字节流的通用接口。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical serial communication component used in laboratory systems. It provides generic byte-stream write, read, and close operations over a serial port for higher-level software to communicate with serial devices.

actions.description_en: Write data to the serial stream.

actions.description: 从串口流读取指定长度的数据。
actions.description_en: Read a specified amount of data from the serial stream.
